essence: The oblation should be offered in the same manner as previously instructed.
For propitiation, the heart mantra begins with one's own seed and has ten syllables.
One should perform hand and limb assignments as for a one-syllable mantra and then meditate.
After meditating and worshipping mentally, one should perform the placement of the conch.
One should complete the rite from incense onward through dismissal.
